children: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. reported a wider full-year 2026 loss, with net loss of $(42.9M) versus $(31.6M) in FY2025, and diluted loss per share of $(1.43) compared with $(3.95) in the prior year; the company ended the year with improved liquidity, holding $19.5M in cash and working capital of $17.3M as of June 30, 2026 versus $3.8M cash and a working capital deficit of $(1.8M) a year earlier.
Net income: $(42.9M) for FY2026, compared with $(31.6M) in FY2025 (loss widened by $11.3M, 36% YoY).
Diluted earnings per share: $(1.43) for FY2026 versus $(3.95) for FY2025.
Cash and working capital: Cash $19.5M and working capital $17.3M at June 30, 2026 vs. cash $3.8M and working capital deficit $(1.8M) at June 30, 2025 (improved liquidity).
Project development: Advanced a pre-feasibility study for Phase 1 — a 130k tpa boric acid project — with an estimated capex of $435M ±25% and a target commercial start in 2030.
Operational validation: The SSF was operated to generate technical data; horizontal sidetracks validated parameters but were later impaired.
Product and R&D momentum: Progressed programs for meta boric acid and ferroboron, filed provisional patents, and advanced customer sampling.
Commercial progress: Secured non-binding offtake heads and customer interest from domestic buyers and distributors to support project bankability.
Engineering and financing: Moving forward with FEL-3/FEED work and pursuing EXIM and other financing options to support construction readiness.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
